settings.title: Sharpest with white, red, gold, or green.
settings.text: Black gives the most contrast. Use it when the bag needs to look modern and intentional from across the cart path.

settings.title: Cleanest with black, navy, red, or green.
settings.text: White works best when the accent is repeated sparingly. Too many colors will make it look less premium.

settings.title: Strong with white, gold, red, or light blue.
settings.text: Navy is the safest athletic base. It looks expensive when the accent is simple and consistent.

settings.title: Best with cream, white, black, or gold.
settings.text: Green should feel classic, not loud. Keep the accent restrained and let the golf signal do the work.

settings.title: Use black, white, navy, or gold.
settings.text: Red is already the statement. Pair it with a quiet accent and avoid stacking too many highlight colors.

settings.title: Base first
settings.text: The bag color is the anchor. Everything else should respond to it.

settings.title: One accent
settings.text: Pick one accent and repeat it across towel, cover, marker, and small cart details.

settings.title: Stop early
settings.text: A bag looks more premium when the color system is clear and restrained.

settings.heading: Make the bag look matched.
settings.subheading: A quick color system for choosing accessories that look like they belong together without overdecorating the setup.
